answer_1.quote: To evaluate DenseLoRA's performance on commonsense reasoning tasks, we fine-tune LLaMA2-7B and LLaMA3-8B using a dataset comprising 170k training samples . These samples are drawn from the training sets of eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks: 1) BoolQ ; 2) PIQA ; 3) SIQA ; 4) HellaS. (HellaSwag) ; 5) WinoG. (WinoGrande) ; 6) ARC-c and ARC-e ; 7) OBQA .

answer_2.quote: DenseLoRA achieves an average accuracy of 85% on LLaMA3-8B
